The project organizes APIs by type and functionality, making it easier for developers to discover and integrate various services into their applications without cost barriers.

items.name: react
items.summary: React 是由 Facebook 开发的 JavaScript 库，专门用于构建用户界面，特别是网页应用程序。它采用声明式编程范式，允许开发者创建可复用的 UI 组件。React 能够在数据变化时高效地更新和渲染组件，为复杂界面提供优异的性能表现。该库支持 Web 和原生移动应用开发，通过 React Native 扩展了其跨平台能力。
items.summary_en: React is a JavaScript library developed by Facebook for building user interfaces, particularly for web applications. It enables developers to create reusable UI components using a declarative programming approach. React efficiently updates and renders components when data changes, providing optimal performance for complex interfaces. The library supports both web and native mobile application development through React Native.

It enables developers to create reusable UI components using a declarative programming approach. React efficiently updates and renders components when data changes, providing optimal performance for complex interfaces. The library supports both web and native mobile application development through React Native.

items.name: ohmyzsh
items.summary: Oh My Zsh 是一个社区驱动的 Zsh shell 配置管理框架。该项目提供超过 300 个插件，支持 Git、Docker、Python、Node.js 等多种工具和平台，以及 140 多个主题用于终端自定义。包含自动更新工具，拥有 2400 多名开发者的贡献。通过丰富的插件和主题选项，简化了 shell 配置管理并提升了命令行工作效率，使终端使用更加便捷和个性化。
items.summary_en: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing Zsh shell configurations. It provides over 300 plugins for various tools and platforms including Git, Docker, Python, and Node.js, plus 140+ themes for terminal customization. The project includes an auto-update tool and has contributions from more than 2,400 developers. It simplifies shell configuration management and enhances command-line productivity through extensive plugin and theme options.

items.name: bootstrap
items.summary: Bootstrap 是一个流行的开源前端框架，用于网页开发。提供 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 组件，用于构建响应式、移动优先的网站。该框架包含网格系统、预构建组件和 Sass 变量用于自定义。Bootstrap 使开发者能够快速创建一致、跨浏览器兼容的网页界面，同时保持响应式设计原则，确保在各种设备上获得最佳显示效果，简化了现代网页开发流程。
items.summary_en: Bootstrap is a popular open-source front-end framework for web development. It provides HTML, CSS, and JavaScript components for building responsive, mobile-first websites. The framework includes a grid system, pre-built components, and Sass variables for customization. Bootstrap enables developers to create consistent, cross-browser compatible web interfaces quickly while maintaining responsive design principles for optimal viewing on various devices.

items.name: flutter
items.summary: Flutter是由Google开发的开源UI软件开发工具包，用于从单一代码库构建Android、iOS、Linux、macOS、Windows和Web的跨平台应用程序。它使用Dart编程语言，提供丰富的预设计组件，遵循Material Design设计原则。该框架编译为原生代码，并使用Skia图形引擎进行渲染，能够创建具有流畅动画的高性能应用。Flutter支持热重载功能，允许开发者在运行应用程序时实时查看代码更改效果，显著提高开发效率。
items.summary_en: Flutter is an open-source UI software development kit created by Google. It is used to develop cross-platform applications for Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows, and the web from a single codebase. Flutter uses the Dart programming language and provides a rich set of pre-designed widgets following Material Design principles. The framework compiles to native code and uses the Skia graphics engine for rendering, enabling high-performance applications with smooth animations.

items.summary: JavaGuide 是一个面向 Java 开发者的综合性学习和面试准备指南。该项目涵盖了 Java 程序员需要掌握的核心知识体系，包括 Java 基础、JVM 原理、Spring 框架、数据库技术（MySQL、Redis）、系统设计、算法等多个重要领域。内容组织系统全面，既适合初学者系统学习，也适合有经验的开发者面试准备和知识巩固。在 GitHub 上获得了大量关注和贡献，已成为 Java 技术学习和面试准备的重要参考资料，帮助开发者构建完整的知识结构。
items.summary_en: JavaGuide is a comprehensive learning and interview preparation guide for Java developers. It covers essential core knowledge required by most Java programmers, including Java fundamentals, JVM principles, Spring framework, database technologies like MySQL and Redis, and system design concepts. The resource is specifically designed to help developers prepare for technical interviews while also serving as a reference for ongoing learning. It has gained significant traction in the Java community with extensive GitHub engagement.

items.name: javascript
items.summary: Airbnb JavaScript 风格指南为编写一致、可维护的 JavaScript 代码提供了全面的编码规范。该指南涵盖 ES6+ 特性、命名约定、箭头函数和现代语法模式，可作为团队通过 ESLint 配置强制执行代码质量的参考标准。其优势包括详细的代码示例、实用建议以及与 TC39 规范的兼容性。典型应用场景包括团队代码标准化、新开发人员入职培训，以及集成代码检查工具来自动化执行 JavaScript 项目的风格规范，确保代码质量和团队协作效率。
items.summary_en: The Airbnb JavaScript Style Guide provides comprehensive coding standards for writing consistent, maintainable JavaScript code. It covers ES6+ features, naming conventions, arrow functions, and modern syntax patterns. The guide serves as a reference for teams to enforce code quality through ESLint configurations. Its strengths include detailed examples, practical recommendations, and alignment with TC39 specifications. Typical use cases include team code standardization, onboarding new developers, and integrating with linting tools to automate style enforcement across JavaScript projects.

items.name: next.js
items.summary: Next.js 是一个基于 React 的框架，用于构建具有服务器端渲染和静态站点生成功能的 Web 应用程序。它提供自动代码分割、优化性能和简化部署等功能。该框架支持混合渲染模式，允许开发人员在服务器渲染页面和静态生成页面之间进行选择。它包含内置的 CSS 支持、API 路由和零配置设置，用于高效开发生产就绪的应用程序。
items.summary_en: Next.js is a React-based framework for building web applications with server-side rendering and static site generation capabilities. It provides features like automatic code splitting, optimized performance, and simplified deployment. The framework supports hybrid rendering modes, allowing developers to choose between server-rendered and statically generated pages. It includes built-in CSS support, API routes, and zero-configuration setup for efficient development of production-ready applications.

items.name: go
items.summary: Go是由Google开发的开源编程语言，旨在构建简单、可靠且高效的软件。该语言具有垃圾回收、结构类型和CSP风格的并发特性。Go能够快速编译为机器代码，并拥有强大的标准库。它常用于系统编程、Web开发和云服务领域。该项目是Go编程语言实现和文档的官方仓库，提供了完整的语言规范、编译器工具链和丰富的标准库支持。
items.summary_en: Go is an open-source programming language developed by Google. It is designed for building simple, reliable, and efficient software. It is commonly used for system programming, web development, and cloud services. The project serves as the official repository for the Go programming language implementation and documentation.

items.name: react-native
items.summary: React Native 是由 Facebook 开发的开源框架，用于使用 React 构建原生移动应用程序。它允许开发者使用 JavaScript 和 React 原则为 iOS 和 Android 平台创建应用，同时提供原生性能。该框架提供对平台特定 API 和组件的访问，支持使用单一代码库进行跨平台开发。在 GitHub 上拥有超过 12 万颗星，广泛应用于移动开发领域，特别适合需要同时覆盖多个移动操作系统的项目。
items.summary_en: React Native is an open-source framework developed by Facebook for building native mobile applications using React. It enables developers to create apps for both iOS and Android platforms using JavaScript and React principles while delivering native performance. The framework provides access to platform-specific APIs and components, allowing for cross-platform development with a single codebase. With over 123,000 GitHub stars, it's widely used in mobile development.

items.name: PowerToys
items.summary: Microsoft PowerToys 是一个开源工具集合，旨在增强 Windows 用户体验和提高工作效率。它包含多种实用工具，如用于窗口管理的 FancyZones、用于批量文件重命名的 PowerRename、用于颜色选择的 Color Picker 以及用于按键重新映射的 Keyboard Manager。这些工具帮助用户自定义 Windows 环境并简化日常任务。该项目在 GitHub 上获得超过 12 万颗星，支持 Windows 10 和 Windows 11 操作系统，为 Windows 用户提供了强大的系统增强功能。
items.summary_en: Microsoft PowerToys is an open-source collection of utilities designed to enhance Windows user experience and productivity. It includes various tools like FancyZones for window management, PowerRename for batch file renaming, Color Picker for color selection, and Keyboard Manager for key remapping. These utilities help users customize their Windows environment and streamline common tasks. The project has gained significant popularity with over 123,000 GitHub stars and supports both Windows 10 and Windows 11.

items.name: kubernetes
items.summary: Kubernetes 是一个开源的容器编排平台，用于自动化部署、扩展和管理容器化应用程序。由云原生计算基金会开发，提供服务发现、负载均衡、存储编排、自动滚动更新和回滚等工具。使用 Go 语言编写，支持多种容器运行时，通过声明式配置实现在多种托管环境中的自动化管理，帮助构建可扩展的分布式系统。
items.summary_en: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Developed by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, it provides tools for service discovery, load balancing, storage orchestration, automated rollouts and rollbacks. Written in Go, it supports various container runtimes and enables declarative configuration and automation across multiple hosting environments.

items.name: axios
items.summary: axios 是一个基于 Promise 的 HTTP 客户端，适用于浏览器和 Node.js 环境。它提供了简洁的 API 用于发送 HTTP 请求和处理响应。该库支持所有现代 HTTP 方法，并包含请求/响应拦截、自动 JSON 数据转换、客户端 XSRF 防护等功能。在 GitHub 上拥有超过 10.7 万星标，是 JavaScript 应用程序中处理跨平台 HTTP 通信的流行选择。
items.summary_en: axios is a promise-based HTTP client for both browser and Node.js environments. It provides a simple API for making HTTP requests and handling responses. The library supports all modern HTTP methods and includes features like request/response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, and client-side protection against XSRF. With over 107,000 GitHub stars, it's a popular choice for handling HTTP communications in JavaScript applications across different platforms.

items.name: excalidraw
items.summary: Excalidraw 是一个虚拟白板应用程序，用于创建手绘风格的图表和草图。它具有简单直观的界面，模拟在物理白板上绘图的体验。该工具支持实时协作功能，允许多个用户同时在同一个画布上工作。专为生产力和图表创建设计，能够创建各种类型的视觉表示。该项目在 GitHub 上获得了超过 10.7 万星标，具有很高的流行度。
items.summary_en: Excalidraw is a virtual whiteboard application for creating hand-drawn style diagrams and sketches. It features a simple, intuitive interface that mimics the experience of drawing on physical whiteboards. The tool supports real-time collaboration, allowing multiple users to work on the same canvas simultaneously. It's designed for productivity and diagram creation, with capabilities for creating various types of visual representations. The project has gained significant popularity with over 107,000 GitHub stars.
